template_lines: Shifting from an (adverb) (verb) to a (adverb) (verb) demeanour/tone
example: Shifting from a passionately presenting to a vigorously highlighting demeanour/tone, Khaled GPT wholeheartedly substantiates his piece by forthrightly outlining the importance of eating chocolate in an environment of healthy foods.
linking_template: In this way, the (author) (adverb) substantiates their (type of piece) by transitioning to highlighting ...
linking_example: In this way, the Art and Media Club didactically substantiates their letter by transitioning to highlighting the inconsiderate nature of the Bankswood Council in that it privileges bland offices over the creativity of the community.
